notes: Daily ChatGPT selection from the fresh 72-hour Google Trends YouTube Search run. 187 deduped candidates were reviewed across US, Canada and Taiwan. Twelve Explore requests were attempted, eleven succeeded; TW/財報 failed because the Explore page did not render the chart, but there was no 429 and the RSS/raw pool was otherwise fresh. Duplicate long-tail queries were merged; sports, entertainment, creator/channel names, generic how-to/evergreen queries and low-value noise were removed. Dynamic relevance_groups are intentionally recall-safe and are used only to determine whether returned YouTube titles are substantially about each selected entity/topic before metrics are calculated.
